subject: Renewal + Capacity Uplift — procurement portal upload & onboarding refresh
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dobson <jane.dobson@acmepharma.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — onboarding & procurement steps

Hi Jane —

Great speaking yesterday. Per our call, Acme is set to renew the existing contract for the Redwood inference platform and increase committed capacity by 40% starting on the renewal date. To keep the onboarding refresh and procurement timeline tight, here’s the plan I propose: 

1) Contracts: Laura (cc'ed) will provide an updated SOW and a short term-amendment (30-day signature window).
2) Procurement portal: once the PO is ready Acme uploads it to your procurement portal link; we'll validate and mark the order for provisioning.
3) Security evidence: we'll attach the SOC2 summary and the new onboarding checklist so your IT/security can clear the expansion.
4) Provisioning: Markus will schedule the capacity uplift once we receive PO and signed amendment.

Action items for Acme: please confirm the billing entity and whether the PO will live in your portal (procurement@acmepharma.com). If you expect any legal redlines, flag them now so Laura can address them.

I attached the latest draft SOW (redwood-SOW-v3.docx) for your review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-SOW-v3.docx (docx)

From: Jane Dobson <jane.dobson@acmepharma.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Pharma Procurement <procurement@acmepharma.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmepharma.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — onboarding & procurement steps

Sergio — thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from procurement and security: 

- Procurement will upload POs to our portal. We expect the PO to reference the SOW version and include the 12-month term change (start: 2026-11-01).
- Security (Tom) requested the SOC2 summary and an architecture diagram for the private deployment option; the SOC2 summary looks fine from a quick skim.
- Legal: our GC wants a short note on data residency and retention — can Laura include a one-paragraph addendum?

I'll coordinate the PO upload by Friday 10/01. Please confirm an internal contact for billing reconciliation and who will receive the procurement portal confirmation email.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Dobson
Procurement Lead | Acme Pharma
jane.dobson@acmepharma.com

Reference: Acme PO workflow doc (we'll upload PO to https://procurement.acmepharma.com/portal)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dobson <jane.dobson@acmepharma.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — onboarding & procurement steps

Hi Jane —

Thanks for the note. Happy to add a one-paragraph data residency/retention addendum; suggested language below for your legal team to review: 

"Redwood will store and process data in the United States region associated with Acme Pharma's account unless otherwise agreed in writing. Data retention policies for logs and telemetry are set forth in Exhibit B; customer-controlled deletion policies are available via the Redwood Console. Any additional residency requirements will be handled via a Private deployment addendum with mutually agreed terms."

If that helps, I can include it in the short Amendment and send a DocuSign link today for signature. Also noting: please flag if you need any other operational SLAs (latency/uptime) in the Amendment; default SLA clauses will remain unchanged unless requested.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: none

P.S. Sergio / Priyom — once Jane confirms PO upload, please hold off provisioning until the signed Amendment is in DocuSign and the PO copy is visible in Acme's procurement portal. We need both for billing and compliance records.

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dobson <jane.dobson@acmepharma.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — onboarding & procurement steps

Hi Jane — quick operational note from the onboarding side: 

- Once the PO is uploaded, please forward the portal confirmation email to onboarding@redwood.com (or cc me) — that triggers the provisioning runbook.
- Capacity uplift plan: we will stage a 2-week ramp (10% increments every 3 days) to validate performance and billing metrics.
- If you want the private deployment, let us know now (it affects lead time). Otherwise we'll provision hosted dedicated capacity in your region (US-West).

I can schedule a 30-minute runbook walkthrough with your IT team this week. Open slots: 10/02 15:00-15:30 PT or 10/03 09:00-09:30 PT.

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

From: Jane Dobson <jane.dobson@acmepharma.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Pharma Procurement <procurement@acmepharma.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmepharma.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity uplift — onboarding & procurement steps

Thanks everyone — quick status update: 

- PO uploaded to the procurement portal (PO# ACME-98765). I've attached the portal confirmation and a signed PO PDF for your records.
- Legal accepted the one-paragraph residency addendum; I signed the DocuSign amendment just now. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rdw/acme/4521 (attached).
- Security (Tom) confirmed SOC2 summary is acceptable; he will set up a short call with Priyom if we need to review networking details.

Next steps as I understand them: 
- Redwood to confirm receipt of signed amendment & PO and then schedule provisioning window.
- Priyom to run the onboarding ramp and share the provisioning schedule.
- Laura and Acme legal to archive the signed amendment.

I've attached: Acme_PO_20261001.pdf, procurement-portal-confirmation.png, DocuSign-ack-4521.pdf

Best,
Jane

Attachments: Acme_PO_20261001.pdf (pdf), procurement-portal-confirmation.png (png), DocuSign-ack-4521.pdf (pdf)
